Subject: Submission of Transcript of Earnings Conference Call held on October 15, 2026.
For Polycab India Limited
--- page 2 ---
“Polycab India Limited
Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call”
October 15, 2026
MANAGEMENT: MR. NIKHIL JAISINGHANI – JOINT MANAGING
DIRECTOR – POLYCAB INDIA LIMITED
MR. NIYANT MARU – CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER –
POLYCAB INDIA LIMITED
MR.SHASHANK YAGNICK – HEAD, INVESTOR RELATIONS
Page 1 of 4
--- page 3 ---
Polycab India Limited
October 15, 2026
Moderator: Ladies and gentlemen, good day, and welcome to the Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call. I now hand the
conference over to Mr. Rahul Jain. Thank you and over to you, sir.
Rahul Jain: Thank you. I would now like to hand over to the management for their opening remarks.
Niyant Maru: Thank you. Our capex for the year will be in line with our annual guidance of INR 12 billion to INR 16
billion per annum. We continue to maintain our medium- to long-term margin guidance of 11% to 13% for this
business. We were at full year basis, we were at 70-75% kind of utilization.
Moderator: Thank you. The first question is from the line of CA Garvit from Serene Alpha. Please go ahead.
--- page 4 ---
Polycab India Limited
October 15, 2026
Garvit: Thanks. During the Analyst Day, you spoke about an aspiration of achieving 22% to 24% by FY '29. That
aspiration can still hold? Or would you worry about it a bit?
Nikhil Jaisinghani: Yes, that aspiration holds. We expect EBITDA margins to remain in the range of 13% to 15% for
the full year.
Moderator: Thank you. Next question is from the line of Shrenik Bachhawat from Mahindra MF.
--- page 5 ---
Polycab India Limited
October 15, 2026
Shrenik B: What is the outlook for exports? Will it grow 20% next year?
Shashank Yagnick: We expect exports to grow faster than the company average next year.
Moderator: Thank you. That was the last question.
--- page 6 ---
Polycab India Limited
October 15, 2026
Moderator: On behalf of the company, that concludes this conference.
